query: UPDATE central.artifact_reconciliation_claims c SET claim_kind = 'normal', lease_expires_at = clock_timestamp(), updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE c.claim_kind = 'large' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM central.artifacts a WHERE a.workspace_id = c.workspace_id AND a.id = c.artifact_id AND a.state NOT IN ('ready', 'rejected'))
